crossRefs.note: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days…
Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he…
One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

parallels.note: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

translations.web: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
translations.bsb: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
translations.kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
translations.asv: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?
